text: i like this game and the art and the idea behind it and the mechanics, but it gets quite overwhelming the further through you get. i have also encountered a couple of bugs that result in just having to reset the day, when you have like 40 patrons and its close to the end its incredibly frustrating. i also find that earnings vs debt is unbalanced, it feels as though you will never get out of your debt

No real difficulty progression, it hits you with every mechanics right out the gate.
After 4 shifts you about have seen all the game has to offer in terms of mechanics.

The yokai that drive the story sometimes have random modifiers, some of them are cleared very easily, others are just frustrating with how the game works.
Don't try to go for perfect shifts, a single misplace will cost you the entire shift if for example, you place one of the soot sprites 1 tile of or accidentally drop an item on top of it, which happens a lot with how finnicky the controls are.
You might have some fun with it if you can get it on sale, but i still wouldn't recommend it.
Could have been a nice cozy game, instead it's just tedious for the sake of being tedious.
Art is fantastic and the mechanics are unique. But thats all. Its overwhelming and boring. Not for me.

I want to like this game but the controller controlls need a massive update. It's almost impossible to select what you need to and moving the hand under the tray is the same. Hopefully this issue is resolved soon.

4/10 thought it would be more complex
tweaking the sensitivity but the controller tray tilt control just wasnt working for me at all
every menu is janky weird controller style ive never seen before in games
end up spending more time than i should trying to press one of two menu options i have up

I really really wanted to like this game. The art is adorable and the mechanics are unique. Sadly it seems like the devs are not interested in updating it or answering questions/addressing game play issues. There are a number of bugs (half the menus just display ???) and despite getting perfects on every level you never seem to get enough money to accomplish anything. I had to switch from controller to mouse + keyboard because the controller controls were so poor. Keep that in mind if you plan to play on steamdeck. Specifically you need to move the left joystick to move the tray and the right joystick to move the hand. But moving the left joystick also runs through the menu at the top. So often times you're selecting the wrong things. The only updates from the devs are posting about sales and promotions. If the devs get around to responding to people and making adjustments (it's been out a month now with no patches and no responses to anyone) then I'll happily purchase again. For now I am sadly asking for a refund as I find the game unplayable.

The game is really pretty and honestly i really wanted to love the game, however the whole game feels like a noose that keeps getting tighter for small mistakes.

so much of the game was stressful for no reason as each mistake would make the next customer harder and harder to deal with, not to mention the uneven payment.
there are things called "soot" as well as other harmful things that if you drop them the game counts it as "food" and would tax you for dropping "food" but if you have it on your plate then you also get your food ruined which makes it impossible to finish any order after a while.

do yourself a favor skip this one since the devs also seem to want to skip it too.
